name: Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber
archDisplay: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformer (configuration undisclosed), fine-tuned from Gemini 3.5 Flash for cybersecurity vulnerability discovery, validation and patching
note: Fine-tune of Gemini 3.5 Flash specialized for finding, validating and patching security vulnerabilities, released alongside Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite on July 21, 2026 but exclusive to Google's CodeMender program for governments and trusted partners — no public API, no published pricing (apiAvailable/price reflect that, not a data gap), no disclosed standalone context window (1M inherited from base 3.5 Flash as a best estimate). Within CodeMender, up to five Cyber calls are combined into one report.
